"CIRCUIT"
Warm up: Warm up muscle group - 30s Straight bar stretch, 30s Banded Pull Aparts, 30s 90/90 DB external rotation, 30s Light DB shoulder press
1. Bench Press 4,6,8,10 reps
* card lists reps as 10-8-6-4 reps, no % given
2. Alt DB Front Raise 3 sets of 12 reps
3. Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown 4,6,8,10 reps
* card lists reps as 10-8-6-4 reps, no % given
4. Cable Rope Tricep Extension 3 sets of 10 reps
5. Side Rear Delt Fly Machine 3 sets of 12 reps
6. Push Ups 3 sets
* reps listed as F-F-F (failure each set)
7. Row 1 set
* 10 min
